title: <run-dir>/commissaire/governor/governor.json
description: The governor's secret custody file, minted by `contract admit` into --governor-dir. Holds the Ed25519 keypair (PEM) plus the HMAC `master_secret` from which each producer's K_producer is HKDF-derived. NEVER shipped to a producer; the producer receives only pk.json. Shape normative here; semantics in ../keypair.md. The shipped example redacts the secret halves (`sk`, `master_secret`) — a deliberate publication redaction, not the on-disk shape.

sk.description: Ed25519 private key, PKCS8 PEM — governor custody only

pk.description: Ed25519 public key, PEM — the published half

pk_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the public key

master_secret.description: hex HMAC master; K_producer = HKDF(master_secret, ...) — governor custody only
